name: WAS AIX fix pack
description: Which product, to which version, in which home. The version installed is read from <home>/bin/versionInfo.sh; when it differs, the fix pack is applied from Fixes/FP<version> on the binaries share, as was.

spec.question_description: was: WAS ND. sdk: the Java SDK of the WAS home. was-sdk: both. ihs: IBM HTTP Server. plg: the web server plugin. ihs-plg: both.
spec.choices:
was
sdk
was-sdk
ihs
plg
ihs-plg

spec.question_description: The WAS ND fix pack level, from Fixes/FP<version>/WAS.
The IBM HTTP Server fix pack level, from Fixes/FP<version>/IHSPLG.
The web server plugin fix pack level, from Fixes/FP<version>/IHSPLG.
The Java SDK 8 level, from Fixes/FP*/SDK/<version>.
Where WAS ND is installed. Several homes separated by commas: /usr/IBM/WebSphere9/AppServerDmgr,/usr/IBM/WebSphere9/AppServerNode1
Where IBM HTTP Server is installed.
Where the web server plugin is installed.
